IVX HOLDINGS — ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION FINAL COMPLETION
ONE ITEM AT A TIME — IMPLEMENT, TEST, DEPLOY, VERIFY

CURRENT HONEST STATUS

- Backend enterprise registration: BUILT
- Database migration: APPLIED
- Duplicate prevention: VERIFIED
- Enterprise invitations: VERIFIED
- Cross-enterprise isolation: VERIFIED
- Membership actions: PARTIALLY VERIFIED
- KYC/AML separation: VERIFIED
- Audit trail: VERIFIED
- Server validation: VERIFIED
- Production E2E backend tests: 13 PASS

CURRENT SCORE:

17/32 VERIFIED
15 ITEMS PARTIAL, NOT BUILT, OR NOT TESTED

Do not repeat completed backend work.
Do not return a new general report.
Complete the following items in order.

GLOBAL RULES

For every item:

1. Inspect the actual implementation.
2. State the current defect.
3. Identify the root cause.
4. Modify the real production code.
5. Add or update tests.
6. Run the exact acceptance tests.
7. Commit the change.
8. Deploy when required.
9. Verify in production.
10. Return evidence.
11. Stop before starting the next item.

Never report VERIFIED when an item is partial, skipped, blocked, or tested only through HTTP 200.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — COMPLETE THE CANONICAL IDENTITY MODEL
==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: PARTIAL

The members identity model is missing required enterprise-registration fields.

Add or correctly map:

- enterprise_id
- normalized_email
- normalized_phone
- country_code
- primary_role
- secondary_roles
- registration_type
- registration_status
- email_verified_at
- phone_verified_at
- identity_status
- kyc_status
- aml_status
- owner_review_status
- source_channel
- data_origin
- terms_version
- privacy_version
- terms_accepted_at
- audit_trace_id

Requirements:

- One auth identity maps to one canonical member.
- One member may have multiple approved roles.
- Enterprise users link to one enterprise membership.
- Existing production members must be backfilled safely.
- No existing member data may be lost.
- Test and fake records must remain distinguishable.
- Unique normalized email and auth_user_id constraints must be enforced.

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Existing member loads after migration
[ ] New individual registration creates complete identity
[ ] New enterprise registration creates complete identity
[ ] Duplicate email is rejected
[ ] Duplicate auth identity is rejected
[ ] Existing incomplete member can be recovered
[ ] No orphan member is created
[ ] No role-specific duplicate identity is created
[ ] Rollback is tested

Required final result:

CANONICAL IDENTITY: VERIFIED
MISSING REQUIRED FIELDS: 0
ORPHAN IDENTITIES: 0
DUPLICATE ACTIVE IDENTITIES: 0

STOP AFTER ITEM 1.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — BUILD THE THREE-STEP ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION UI
==================================================

Start only after Item 1 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT BUILT

Build the actual Expo and web enterprise registration flow.

STEP 1 — ACCOUNT

- First name
- Last name
- Email
- Phone
- Password or approved passwordless method
- Terms acceptance
- Privacy acceptance

STEP 2 — REGISTRATION TYPE

Allow one primary selection:

- Investor
- Buyer
- JV Partner
- Tokenized Interest
- Enterprise
- Broker or Agent
- Lender
- Vendor or Contractor

STEP 3 — ENTERPRISE DETAILS

- Legal company name
- Display company name
- Company type
- Industry
- Website
- Address
- City
- State
- ZIP/postal code
- Country
- Authorized representative
- Representative title
- Team size
- Business category
- Optional supporting documents

Required UX:

- Maximum three screens
- Progress indicator
- Back button
- No lost form data
- Draft persistence
- Field-level validation
- International phone input
- Keyboard-safe layout
- Loading state
- Submission lock
- Duplicate-submit prevention
- Real error messages
- Real confirmation ID
- Accessibility labels

Do not reuse an individual-only form and call it enterprise registration.

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Expo enterprise screen exists
[ ] Web enterprise screen exists
[ ] Three-step navigation works
[ ] Back navigation preserves data
[ ] Refresh or restart preserves recoverable draft
[ ] Required fields block submission
[ ] Double tap creates one request only
[ ] Server errors display correctly
[ ] Confirmation shows real enterprise and trace IDs

STOP AFTER ITEM 2.

==================================================
ITEM 3 — CONNECT CLIENT VALIDATION TO SERVER VALIDATION
==================================================

Start only after Item 2 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: PARTIAL

Implement matching validation on Expo, web, and backend.

Validate:

- First and last name
- Email format
- Email normalization
- Phone format
- Country code
- Password rules
- Company legal name
- Company website
- Company type
- Industry
- Address
- ZIP/postal code
- Authorized representative
- Role selection
- Terms acceptance
- Privacy acceptance
- Uploaded file type
- Uploaded file size
- Invitation token
- Duplicate enterprise
- Duplicate identity

Rules:

- Client validation improves UX.
- Backend validation is authoritative.
- Invalid data must create zero production records.
- All validation errors must use stable error codes.
- Every rejected submission must have a trace ID.

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Invalid email rejected
[ ] Invalid phone rejected
[ ] Missing company name rejected
[ ] Invalid website rejected
[ ] Missing terms rejected
[ ] Oversized file rejected
[ ] Unsupported file rejected
[ ] Modified client payload rejected by backend
[ ] No partial record is created

STOP AFTER ITEM 3.

==================================================
ITEM 4 — EMAIL VERIFICATION FOR ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION
==================================================

Start only after Item 3 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Connect the existing verification system to the enterprise flow.

Required behavior:

- Verification email sent after submission
- Single-use verification link or OTP
- Expiration enforced
- Resend supported
- Resend rate limited
- Old verification token invalidated
- Email change requires new verification
- email_verified_at stored
- Enterprise remains pending until verification requirements pass

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Valid link succeeds
[ ] Invalid link fails
[ ] Expired link fails
[ ] Reused link fails
[ ] Resend works
[ ] Resend limit works
[ ] App restart does not lose pending state
[ ] Browser refresh does not lose pending state
[ ] Verification audit event exists

STOP AFTER ITEM 4.

==================================================
ITEM 5 — PHONE VERIFICATION FOR ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION
==================================================

Start only after Item 4 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Required behavior:

- OTP sent to normalized phone
- OTP expiration
- Single use
- Retry limit
- Resend cooldown
- Rate limit
- Incorrect code rejected
- Phone change triggers re-verification
- phone_verified_at stored
- Failed SMS delivery remains visible

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Valid OTP succeeds
[ ] Invalid OTP fails
[ ] Expired OTP fails
[ ] Reused OTP fails
[ ] Excess attempts blocked
[ ] Resend cooldown enforced
[ ] SMS failure does not show success
[ ] Restart preserves pending verification

STOP AFTER ITEM 5.

==================================================
ITEM 6 — LANDING PAGE ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION
==================================================

Start only after Item 5 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT BUILT

Add a real enterprise-registration entry point to the public landing page.

Required:

- Enterprise option visible
- Opens the approved three-step flow
- Uses production API
- Uses production Supabase project
- No mock records
- No Rork references
- No white top banner
- No layout jumping
- Mobile responsive
- Browser refresh support
- Clear success and failure states
- Confirmation ID
- Member and enterprise records visible to owner

Test on:

- Android Chrome
- iPhone Safari
- Desktop Chrome
- Edge
- Safari or equivalent

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Landing form opens
[ ] Enterprise submission succeeds
[ ] Duplicate is blocked
[ ] Invalid input is rejected
[ ] Verification works
[ ] Owner dashboard receives the record
[ ] Members module receives the record
[ ] No console error
[ ] No broken asset
[ ] No Rork network request

STOP AFTER ITEM 6.

==================================================
ITEM 7 — CRM SYNCHRONIZATION
==================================================

Start only after Item 6 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT IMPLEMENTED

Synchronize enterprise registration with the correct CRM records.

Mapping rules:

- Enterprise alone does not automatically become an investor.
- Enterprise investor role creates or links an investor CRM record.
- Enterprise buyer role creates or links a buyer CRM record.
- JV role creates or links a JV partner record.
- Lender role creates or links a lender record.
- Broker role creates or links a broker/agent record.
- Vendor role creates or links a vendor record.

Required:

- One canonical member
- One enterprise
- One membership
- Only selected role records
- Source channel preserved
- Consent preserved
- Audit trail created
- Duplicate CRM prevention
- CRM sync status visible

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Investor enterprise syncs to investor CRM
[ ] Buyer enterprise syncs to buyer CRM
[ ] JV enterprise syncs to JV records
[ ] Lender enterprise syncs to lender records
[ ] Unselected roles are not created
[ ] Retry does not duplicate CRM records
[ ] Failed CRM sync remains visible and retryable
[ ] Dashboard totals reconcile

STOP AFTER ITEM 7.

==================================================
ITEM 8 — OWNER ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION CONTROL CENTER
==================================================

Start only after Item 7 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: API EXISTS, UI NOT BUILT

Build the Owner Control Center UI.

Required summary cards:

- Registrations today
- Registrations this week
- Completed
- Failed
- Abandoned
- Pending email verification
- Pending phone verification
- Pending enterprise review
- Pending KYC
- Duplicate review
- Suspended enterprises
- Registrations by role
- Registrations by source
- Registrations by platform
- Error rate
- Conversion rate

Required controls:

- Search
- Filter
- Open registration
- Approve enterprise
- Reject enterprise
- Request information
- Review documents
- Suspend membership
- Reactivate membership
- Remove member
- Transfer enterprise ownership
- Resend verification
- Merge confirmed duplicate
- Review audit history
- Export approved records

All privileged actions require owner authorization and audit records.

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Dashboard loads real data
[ ] Filters work
[ ] Enterprise detail opens
[ ] Approve works
[ ] Reject works
[ ] Request information works
[ ] Suspend works
[ ] Reactivate works
[ ] Transfer ownership works
[ ] Unauthorized user is rejected
[ ] Audit event created for every action

STOP AFTER ITEM 8.

==================================================
ITEM 9 — NOTIFICATION SYSTEM
==================================================

Start only after Item 8 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT IMPLEMENTED

Implement enterprise events for email, SMS, and in-app notifications where appropriate.

Required notifications:

- Registration received
- Email verification
- Phone verification
- Enterprise under review
- More information requested
- Enterprise approved
- Enterprise rejected
- Team invitation
- Invitation accepted
- Invitation expired
- Membership suspended
- Membership reactivated
- Ownership transferred
- Owner warning for suspicious activity

Each notification must store:

- Recipient
- Channel
- Template
- Related enterprise
- Event type
- Sent time
- Delivery status
- Failure
- Retry count
- Audit trace ID

Acceptance tests:

[ ] Correct recipient
[ ] Correct event
[ ] No duplicate send
[ ] Delivery status stored
[ ] Provider failure handled
[ ] Retry limit enforced
[ ] Sensitive data excluded
[ ] Notification audit exists

STOP AFTER ITEM 9.

==================================================
ITEM 10 — DATABASE TRANSACTION AND ROLLBACK RECOVERY
==================================================

Start only after Item 9 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: PARTIAL

Implement explicit recovery for failures during:

- Auth identity creation
- Member creation
- Enterprise creation
- Membership creation
- Role-record creation
- Consent creation
- Audit-log creation
- CRM synchronization
- Verification setup
- Notification dispatch

Required:

- Transaction where technically supported
- Compensating rollback where not supported
- Recoverable status where rollback is impossible
- Safe idempotent retry
- No false success
- No orphan records
- Trace ID for every failure

Force one controlled failure at each step.

Required final values:

ORPHAN AUTH USERS: 0
ORPHAN MEMBERS: 0
ORPHAN ENTERPRISES: 0
ORPHAN MEMBERSHIPS: 0
FALSE SUCCESS RESPONSES: 0
DUPLICATES AFTER RETRY: 0

STOP AFTER ITEM 10.

==================================================
ITEM 11 — COMPLETE RLS AND AUTHORIZATION BYPASS TESTS
==================================================

Start only after Item 10 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: SCHEMA VERIFIED, BYPASS TESTS MISSING

Test:

- Public user assigning enterprise-admin role
- User marking enterprise verified
- User changing KYC or AML status
- User reading another enterprise
- User modifying another enterprise
- User accepting another enterprise’s invitation
- Reused invitation token
- Modified invitation token
- Non-owner using owner endpoints
- Direct Supabase request bypass
- Direct API request bypass
- Audit-log modification
- Service-role key exposure in client

Required final values:

ROLE ESCALATION: 0
CROSS-ENTERPRISE ACCESS: 0
OWNER-ENDPOINT BYPASSES: 0
AUDIT TAMPERING: 0
CLIENT SERVER-SECRETS: 0

STOP AFTER ITEM 11.

==================================================

==================================================

Start only after Item 11 is VERIFIED.

SECRET EXPOSURES: 0

==================================================
ITEM 13 — PERFORMANCE AND CONCURRENCY QA
==================================================

Start only after Item 12 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Run:

- 10 simultaneous registrations
- 25 simultaneous registrations
- 50 simultaneous registrations

Required:

CORRUPTED RECORDS: 0
FALSE SUCCESS RESPONSES: 0

STOP AFTER ITEM 13.

==================================================

==================================================

- Email verification

==================================================

==================================================

Run the same enterprise-registration tests on iOS.

Do not mark PASS based only on configuration inspection.
